snippet.title: Shallow Pond | Gameplay Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
The first trailer for my upcoming game, Shallow Pond!
🌊 If it catches your eye, support me by wishlisting it:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2950750/Shallow_Pond/

Short highlights teaser here: https://youtu.be/UTHHG29I9Io

Shallow Pond is a cozy 3D platformer about diving into the unknown - literally. Swim, run, and explore a dreamy, handcrafted world full of quirky characters, juicy lakes, and lush meadows.
Play as Ripples, a curious little creature in a diving suit, searching for lost treasure, hidden memories, and maybe even a soulmate along the way.

Made with love by solo dev Nimso (Oswin Neumann - hi, that’s me!)
